newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto stocks end higher, but lag U.S. rally.
newsitem.headline: Toronto stocks end higher, but lag U.S. rally.

text.p: * Toronto stocks ended firmer on Tuesday after early weakness on rate jitters * U.S. stocks rallied after Fed kept interest rates unchanged * 83 million shares traded worth C$1.5 bln.

After opening weaker, Toronto stocks ended mixed to firmer on Tuesday, pulled up in the wake of New York's quick reversal after the U.S. Federal Open Market Committee kept short-term interest rates unchanged.
The Toronto Stock Exchange's key 300 Composite Index rose 12.76 points to 6260.14, but declining issues edged out advancers 482 to 475.

New York closed one percent higher at 7303 points after tumbling one percent earlier in the day. "It was a significant snap-back in the market today," said RBC Dominion Securities Investment Advisor Ira Katzin.
